youtube_title: Incognito Mode Is NOT Private. Who Can Still See You? They're Tricking You #5 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #5. You opened an incognito tab, so nobody can see? Incognito only stops your browser saving history, cookies and form data on YOUR device.
Who can still see you? A: nobody. B: websites, your office or college wifi, and your internet provider.
Answer: B. Chrome's own Incognito page says your activity might still be visible to websites you visit, your employer or school, and your internet service provider. In 2024 Google settled a US class action (Brown v. Google) and agreed to delete data collected from private browsing.
Source: Chrome Incognito page; Brown v. Google settlement, 2024.
